events.name: Refiner plates clash
events.head: Refiner plates clashed! The refiners tripped: no stock is going forward to the machine chest.

events.name: Driveshaft snaps
events.head: Dryer driveshaft snaps. Millwrights called in.

events.name: Fire in the dryers
events.head: Fire in the dryer hood! Deluge on, sheet off.

events.name: Fabric runs off
events.head: Forming fabric tracked off the rolls and folded up.

events.name: Press felt blows
events.head: Press felt blown. Crew pulling a new felt.

events.name: Slime build-up
events.head: Slime build-up in the sheet! Speed cut to 70% and the winder is hayout city.

events.name: Ragger tail break
events.head: The ragger tail broke off at the wheel. Pulper stopped until an operator restarts the tail with fresh ragger rope.

events.name: Pulper overflows
events.head: Pulper overflows and floods the bale yard!

events.name: Winder breakdown
events.head: Winder down: a slitter drive failed. Reels are stacking up at the dry end.

events.name: Dryer can wrap
events.head: The sheet wrapped a dryer can! Machine down while the crew spears it free.

events.name: Dye trouble
events.head: Dye pump hiccup! The sheet is coming out in every color. It's all beater until it's sorted.

events.name: HD cleaner blowout
events.head: The HD cleaner blew out! Stock is everywhere. Pulping stopped, and the chest is draining.

events.name: Lightweight cleaners plugged
events.head: Plastic and wax plugged the lightweight cleaners. Stock prep is stopped; the chest is draining.

events.name: Coarse screen down
events.head: The coarse screen rotor seized. Stock prep is stopped; the chest is draining.

events.name: Fine screen basket failure
events.head: A fine screen basket cracked. Stock prep is stopped until it's replaced.

events.name: LC cleaners plugged
events.head: Sand plugged the LC cleaner rejects. Stock prep is stopped; the chest is draining.

events.name: Fog fan down
events.head: The fog remediation fan tripped! The machine keeps running, but the machine room is filling with wet-end fog.

events.name: Thickener blowout
events.head: The disk thickener blew out! Stock is spraying all over stock prep. Nothing reaches the chest until it's fixed.

events.name: Rolls tied together
events.head: The set came off the winder with both rolls tied together! Two operators are on their way with a band saw. Both rolls go to the beater.

events.name: Broken syphon
events.head: A dryer can's syphon broke: the can is filling with condensate and running cold. The sheet comes off wetter and the dryer drive is working harder.

events.name: Steam joint leak
events.head: A dryer steam joint blew out on the drive side! Sheet off back to the wet end until maintenance repacks it.

events.name: Boiler trip
events.head: The boiler tripped! No steam for the dryers. Machine down.

events.name: Stock chest overflows
events.head: Stock chest overflows! A brown river runs across the floor.

assets.stop: The pulper is stopped; the stock chest is draining.
One refiner left: the machine slows to 75%.
One refiner left: the machine slows to 75%.
No stock to the headbox: the machine is down.
The winder is down; reels are stacking up.
